description: Direct air capture (DAC) plays a crucial role in managing industrial emissions. Capture6’s DAC systems can be seamlessly incorporated alongside industrial / water processes to capture CO2 emissions directly from the air as a byproduct of an existing process. This makes their approach much more cost-effective than traditional, cost-prohibitive DAC approaches. By capturing CO2 directly from the environment, DAC helps industries minimize their carbon footprint while maintaining operational efficiency.

CarbonQuest plays a critical role in the Green Molecules™ industry with its cutting-edge carbon capture technology, providing an efficient and cost-effective pathway to reduce CO₂ emissions in commercial and industrial processes. Utilizing a highly optimized pressure swing adsorption technology designed using commercially available components, CarbonQuest captures substantial emissions while converting the CO₂ into a transportable liquid. This not only enhances efficiency but also unlocks additional value through participation in CO₂ markets.

Cemvita is a pioneer in the application of synthetic biology to the fight against climate change, creating custom synthetic microbes that absorb and convert greenhouse emissions. Cemvita provides a carbon-negative solution that helps oil and gas companies decarbonize while transforming their byproducts into potential new revenue sources.

enaDyne innovative and unique cold plasma catalysis technology effectively converts CO2 emissions into valuable synthetic fuels and chemicals. This process, leveraging non-thermal plasma at low temperatures and pressures, provides a profitable solution for industries to transform CO2 waste into useful products, changing the paradigm of what is possible. It also valorizes natural gas, since it is used as a source of hydrogen and co-processed with CO2 to create higher value liquid chemicals.

description: Furno has developed the first modular, small scale cement kiln that uses natural gas instead of coal to decarbonize cement. The kiln maintains and improves the cement cost-effectiveness through a dramatically more efficient production process. The key innovation is their modular kiln which reduces the 4-steps of cement making into a single, efficient and compact stage. Furno can displace large, centralized cement manufacturers similar to how mini-mills displaced the large, centralized steel manufacturers.

Graphitic Energy is highly relevant to the Green Molecules™ industry because its methane pyrolysis technology offers a pathway to produce clean hydrogen from natural gas without releasing CO₂ emissions. By converting natural gas into hydrogen and solid carbon, Graphitic Energy enables gas utilities and producers to participate in the low-carbon energy transition, leveraging existing gas infrastructure while reducing the carbon footprint of industrial hydrogen production.

Vertus developed a system to increase biogas production with minimal additional cost on site. Vertus improvements allow for smaller investments in digesters and upgrading equipment, reducing the footprint and space required to produce biomethane at a higher quality and quantity, ultimately improving the economics and feasibility for renewable natural gas.
